items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: Peter was her husband, he was a member of the orchestra, naturally. And there was Freddie Johnson, Arthur Briggs, Billy Taylor...

ctx.x: Well, let me finish -- before you go ahead, I wanted to get a little bit about Peter Du Conge. You said that he was a New Orleans guy?

Yes, he was from New Orleans, right, yes, yes. Well, I'm going to tell you about him. Now, I tell you that Bricktop hired us all, right, and Peter was her husband, he was a member of the orchestra, naturally.
And there was Freddie Johnson, Arthur Briggs, Billy Taylor, and I can't remember who was on bass now -- Herb Fleming --
